title: Replay Timestep
description: One step emitted by the replay engine -- only information that would have been visible at this point in the real incident timeline.

visible_info.description: Everything a protocol may condition its decision on at this step -- logs, actions taken, alerts fired. Must not leak information from later steps.

ground_truth_label.description: Filled in by coordination from the incident report. Used only for scoring, never exposed to a protocol at decision time.
